analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Modernize a legacy VB6 banking application into C#, ensuring backward compatibility and documenting current functionality.
requirements_understanding: The legacy codebase involves multiple forms and ActiveX controls for banking operations.
Modernization requires translating VB6 components to C# while maintaining existing functionality.
The project must include QA/security checks and deployment for Docker testing.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Use C# for rewriting VB6 components, ensuring compatibility with existing business logic.
Implement a microservices architecture to replace monolithic VB6 structures.
Utilize Docker for local testing to ensure consistent deployment environments.
clarifications_requested: Are there any specific changes to business logic expected during modernization?
What are the performance benchmarks for the modernized application?

output.executive_summary: The project aims to modernize a legacy VB6 banking application into C#, ensuring backward compatibility and enhanced security, with deployment on Docker for testing.

functional_requirements.title: Modernize Login Functionality
functional_requirements.description: Rewrite the login module from VB6 to C#, ensuring secure authentication and backward compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: The login module must authenticate users using existing credentials.
The module must log authentication attempts for audit purposes.
The rewritten module must pass security penetration tests.

functional_requirements.title: Modernize Customer Management
functional_requirements.description: Convert customer management functionalities to C#, maintaining all existing operations.
acceptance_criteria: All customer data operations must match legacy outputs.
The module must support CRUD operations with no data loss.
The module must integrate with existing databases.

functional_requirements.title: Modernize Transaction Processing
functional_requirements.description: Rewrite transaction processing logic in C#, ensuring accurate financial calculations.
acceptance_criteria: Transactions must be processed with the same accuracy as the legacy system.
The system must handle concurrent transactions without errors.
Transaction logs must be generated for each operation.

functional_requirements.title: Implement Docker Deployment
functional_requirements.description: Deploy the modernized application in a Docker container for local testing.
acceptance_criteria: The application must run successfully in a Docker container.
Deployment scripts must automate the container setup.
The Docker environment must replicate production settings.

functional_requirements.title: Modernize Reporting Module
functional_requirements.description: Convert the reporting module to C#, ensuring data accuracy and format consistency.
acceptance_criteria: Reports must match the format and data of legacy reports.
The module must support export to PDF and Excel.
Report generation must complete within defined time limits.

functional_requirements.title: ActiveX Control Replacement
functional_requirements.description: Replace ActiveX controls with equivalent C# components, ensuring UI consistency.
acceptance_criteria: All ActiveX controls must be replaced with C# components.
UI appearance and behavior must remain consistent with the legacy application.
The application must function without ActiveX dependencies.

functional_requirements.title: Security Enhancements
functional_requirements.description: Enhance security measures in the modernized application to meet current standards.
acceptance_criteria: The application must pass OWASP security tests.
Data encryption must be implemented for sensitive information.
User sessions must be securely managed and logged.

functional_requirements.title: Data Migration
functional_requirements.description: Migrate existing data to the new system without loss or corruption.
acceptance_criteria: All legacy data must be accurately migrated to the new system.
Data integrity must be verified post-migration.
The migration process must be documented and repeatable.

non_functional_requirements.title: Performance
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure the modernized application meets performance benchmarks.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Response time under 200ms for 95% of transactions.
acceptance_criteria: The application must handle 1000 concurrent users without degradation.
Response times must not exceed 200ms for 95% of transactions.
Performance tests must be documented and repeatable.

non_functional_requirements.title: Scalability
non_functional_requirements.description: Design the application to scale horizontally with increased load.
acceptance_criteria: The application must support horizontal scaling.
Load tests must demonstrate scalability to 10,000 users.
Scaling operations must not require downtime.

non_functional_requirements.title: Reliability
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure the application maintains high availability and reliability.
acceptance_criteria: The application must have an uptime of 99.9%.
Failover mechanisms must be tested and documented.
The application must recover from failures within 5 minutes.

non_functional_requirements.title: Usability
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure the modernized application is user-friendly and intuitive.
acceptance_criteria: The application must score 4.5/5 in user satisfaction surveys.
User feedback must be collected and analyzed for improvements.
Usability tests must be conducted with end-users.

non_functional_requirements.title: Security
non_functional_requirements.description: Enhance security to protect against modern threats.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Pass all OWASP Top 10 security tests.
acceptance_criteria: The application must pass all OWASP Top 10 security tests.
Security audits must be conducted bi-annually.
Security patches must be applied within 30 days of release.
